_comment: Per-PR diff-coverage allowlist. Paths listed here are exempt from the diff-coverage check (PR-Gate-1 slice 3). Use SPARINGLY — only for files where adding tests is genuinely impossible (e.g., pure Electron lifecycle entry points where mocking is more brittle than the bug we'd be catching) or for type-only modules where coverage is meaningless.
_format: Each path is a posix-style repo-relative path. No glob support yet; list specific files.
_audit: When adding an entry: include a one-line comment-style key (e.g., "_why_<filename>") in the same JSON object explaining the reason. Future readers grep for `_why_` to find the rationales.
_why_src_lifecycle_AppLifecycle_ts: Electron app lifecycle entry. Constructs L1/L2/L4 services and wires them into IpcContext at boot. Mocking the Electron app/BrowserWindow/IPC platform here is more brittle than the bug we'd be catching — broken wiring surfaces at app launch in /verify or /manual-test-launch, and the wired services have their own behavioural tests. Specific risks: typo in the FileEntityProvider construction (PR-F.3) would crash at boot; typo in a getter (e.g., returning the wrong field) would surface the moment any handler uses it.
_why_src_preload_ts: Electron preload script. One-line `ipcRenderer.invoke` bindings that expose IPC channels to the renderer's contextBridge. Cannot be exercised in jest — contextBridge + ipcRenderer require the Electron runtime. The bindings are mechanical wrappers; the real behaviour lives in the IPC handlers (which ARE tested).
_why_zindex_constant_swap: z-index centralization (refactor/zindex-constants-and-occlusion-fix): the diff lines flagged below are NOT behavioural — each is either an `import { Z_INDEX }` line or a `zIndex: Z_INDEX.*` / `zIndex={Z_INDEX.*}` style-property/JSX-prop swap replacing a raw literal of identical value. They live in modal/chrome/style components that have NO render-test harness (none existed pre-PR), and the value is byte-for-byte the same as before (modal=1100, modalChild=1200, etc. are frozen). Correctness of the SCALE is exercised by tests/l6-ui/zIndex.test.ts (ordering/ceiling/frozen-values), and the absence of stray literals by tests/integration/no-stray-high-zindex.test.ts (hard-zero source scan). Writing mount tests for 13 components purely to cover a no-op constant reference is churn with no behavioural assertion. Carve-out is the plan-sanctioned disposition (01_architect_plan.md §test-3, option b).
_why_straggler_centralization_swaps: Straggler constant centralization (refactor/centralize-straggler-constants, chunks 1/4/7): every flagged diff line is either an import declaration or a constant-reference swap replacing one identifier with an imported alias of byte-identical value. No behavioral assertion is possible beyond testing the constant itself (covered in tests/l5-presentation/settings/settingsSchema.test.ts and tests/l6-ui/constants/colors.test.ts). The swap-site files (syncSlice.ts, drag-drop hooks, filesPageUtils.ts, coursesPageUtils.ts) have no existing render/unit test harness. The constant values are pinned by the new test assertions; writing mount tests purely to cover no-op identifier substitutions is churn with zero behavioral assertion.
_why_color_primary_to_navy: Invisible-accent fix (fix/color-primary-to-navy): every flagged diff line is a single CSS-variable swap replacing the nonexistent var(--color-primary) / var(--color-primary-dark) (undefined in theme.css → invalid → no accent) with the project's real primary var(--color-navy) / var(--color-navy-dark). These files have no render-test harness (none existed pre-PR), and the lines are cosmetic style-object property values (UpdatesPage.styles.ts, updatesPageStyles.ts), a getIconStyle() return value (updatesHelpers.ts), a <Suspense> fallback spinner borderTopColor (Layout.tsx app-shell), and a <Bell> icon color (SyncResultToast.tsx) — no logic. The actual fix (no bare var(--color-primary*) reintroduced) is pinned hard-zero by tests/integration/no-undefined-color-primary.test.ts, exactly as the zindex swap is pinned by no-stray-high-zindex.test.ts. Mounting the full router+store harness purely to cover a color string is the same churn-with-zero-assertion the swap blocks above reject.
